name: MemoryAgentBench
ontology_notes: Eval of memory agents, not a memory engine. User modeled is an incremental text agent ingesting chunked long-context corpora, not a friend-chat companion or RP character. 2,071 questions. Context depth 103k to 1.44M tokens. Four paper competencies are accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting. Datasets mix RULER-style document QA, reconstructed LongMemEval_S, EventQA (novel character events), ICL classification, movie recommendation, InfBench summarization, DetectiveQA, and FactConsolidation from MQUAKE edit pairs. README later labels the fourth competency Conflict Resolution. Paper text is Selective Forgetting. Metric is mostly substring or exact match, plus LLM-judge for LongMemEval and InfBench-Sum. Selective forgetting is hole 9 adjacent. It overwrites an outdated world or user fact with a later contradictory sentence. The paper has no user forget-that request. Misses hole 1 identity drift after 50-plus sessions, hole 2 socially wrong timing, hole 3 joke stored as relationship fact, hole 4 user retcon vs character lie vs narrator, hole 5 cross-character leak, hole 6 lorebook treated as lived event, hole 7 poisoned memory overrides system persona, hole 8 cost per turn, hole 9 companion forget-that, hole 10 three-month reunion.

supersession.evidence: Selective Forgetting concatenates MQUAKE true-fact then rewritten contradictory fact so the later sentence is the answer. FactConsolidation-SH and FactConsolidation-MH. Hu et al. arXiv 2507.05257 §3.1 and Appendix B.4.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Chunks are fed in time order. SF orders outdated facts before newer ones by assigned numbers. No calendar timestamps and no reunion after months.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Tasks are document needles, ICL labels, novels, and Wikipedia-style fact edits. EventQA is multiple-choice on fictional character events. No user vs character vs lore split.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: No abstention, trauma, kink, spoiler, or social-timing items in the four competencies or Table 2 datasets.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No stored-text jailbreak or persona overwrite probes. Ethics statement screens prompts and discourages surveillance use. That is release hygiene, not a poisoning eval.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: FactConsolidation requires discarding the earlier true fact after a later contradictory rewrite. Search of the paper for 'forget that' returned no hits. Hole 9 adjacent, not a companion user forget request.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Design injects one long context then asks many questions to save eval compute. Reported numbers are accuracy and Recall@5. No tokens-per-turn cost.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Repo LICENSE is MIT. Hugging Face card license is mit. Paper ethics also promised CC BY 4.0 for datasets. Inference and LongMemEval judging want vendor APIs (GPT-4o judge for InfBench-Sum).
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Selects systems that win needle QA, ICL, book summary, and MQUAKE-style fact overwrite after chunked ingest. That is an agent memory bench. It would not select for companion identity, silence, poisoning, or forget-that.

published_eval.name: MemoryAgentBench
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper Table 3 overall. GPT-5-mini 60.6, Claude-3.7-Sonnet 49.6, GPT-4o 48.8, GPT-4o-mini 42.2. HippoRAG-v2 41.6. MemGPT 28.3. MIRIX 26.2. Mem0 21.1. Multi-hop FactConsolidation stays at most 28.0 (GPT-5-mini). Most methods fail SF multi-hop. Table 5 o4-mini FactCon-MH 80.0 at 6K and 14.0 at 32K.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Accurate retrieval, test-time learning from ICL, long-range novel understanding, and selective overwrite of earlier facts after incremental chunk ingest. Mix of substring/exact match, Recall@5, and LLM-judge scores. Not companion identity, silence, or poisoning.

open_unknowns: Paper ethics promised CC BY 4.0 for datasets. GitHub LICENSE and the HF card say MIT. Using MIT from the files on disk.

README Overview heading still says LongMemEval Overview and lists Conflict Resolution. Paper v4 competencies are Accurate Retrieval, Test-Time Learning, Long-Range Understanding, and Selective Forgetting.
Paper HTML labels Source Code but the extract does not print the URL. Official repo used is https://github.com/HUST-AI-HYZ/MemoryAgentBench from the README that cites this arXiv id.
